info.title: DotCMS Universal API
info.description: DotCMS is a hybrid CMS and digital experience platform for managing content, pages, sites, workflows, users, templates, and related administrative resources through a large REST API surface.

get.description: Retrieves the authenticated user from DotCMS.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

admin.description: Whether the current user has administrative access.

email.description: Email address of the current DotCMS user.

givenName.description: Given name of the current DotCMS user.

loginAs.description: Whether the current session is in login-as mode.

roleId.description: Primary role identifier for the current DotCMS user.

surname.description: Surname of the current DotCMS user.
